notes.title: Update - April 13, 2018 Added English language.
notes.content:
1. Added English language.

2. Added an illustration.

3. In order to have more audiences, the picture of Consummate taking a shower has changed to taking a bath in bathtub, which is more consistent with the scene of the game. It means this game is upgraded to a full-age edition.

PS: The prequel story is in the form of small comic strips. It'll be released as a DLC, and it's about $1.
